sourceReferences.observed: Stores and persists page fields; maps future publish dates to scheduled; scheduler promotes due entries to published; published/static collections are separately queried.
Invokes the database page scheduler during page boot, then builds public pages from published content.
Edit-content view exposes the Images tab and cover-image field.
Page coverImage accessor resolves a stored image key into the app-managed image URL; it returns false when unset.
Pinned alternative theme renders the page cover image accessor in its page template.
Admin-only role selector offers Editor/Administrator; disabled-user password guidance.
Only admin can change role; controller removes posted role for non-admin and calls editUser.
User storage model defines default editor role and saves user records.
Document tool implements upload, move and delete commands and gates course/group access.
Group space checks course/group authorization and redirects or denies access.
Exercise page checks course access, separates edit/tracking rights and imports exercises for editors.
Product insert/edit and variant routes persist stock and stock-disable fields.
Cart update rejects quantities beyond product/variant stock with HTTP 400 before changing the session cart; enforcement depends on stock tracking and product stock-disable configuration.
Customer routes save/update customer address fields and session address values.
Order routes create orders from session/cart data and expose a restricted order-status update route.
Restricted discount settings routes validate start/end dates and discount records.
Article model checks edit-state rights, prepares publication/version fields, saves article data, and persists featured state into the content/frontpage tables.
Featured-article query includes featured flag, publication state and access level.
Article listing filters/state includes publication window, access, and featured data.
Monitor route acts on current user and verifies monitoring permission.
Bugnote submission accepts privacy and time-tracking fields and checks add-note access threshold.
Issue view renders bugnotes from the visible-bugnote query.
Relationship route validates source/destination, same-issue and existing relationship cases.
Attachment route validates bug/file input, upload limit and bug access.
Move operation checks permissions, validates source/target and exposes optional redirect creation.
Watch action integrates current page with user watchlist and expiry configuration.
UploadBase validates filename/extensions and reports title errors; successful performUpload delegates to LocalFile::upload; frontend error rendering is not inferred.
Revision store inserts revision rows and exposes lookup by revision ID; caller/UI link is corroborated by PageUpdater.
Normal page-update commit path inserts new revisions through RevisionStore and updates page latest revision.
Cart-rule model carries per-customer quantity, minimum amount, carrier/product restrictions and checks validity.

Carrier model calculates range-based delivery prices and filters carriers for an order; range_behavior=disabled removes out-of-range carriers, while other configured behavior permits fallback pricing.
Order validation writes order and history data and synchronizes stock where configured.
Available-stock model supports quantity update and synchronization.
